operator_stimulus: Extend the conjecture net or create a connected successor reflecting the Shoshin research brief v3 and subsequent checked work.

objective.statement: Relative to a fully declared source and parameter discipline, derive a classified family of admissible structured operations whose internal comparisons and higher witnesses compose coherently while retaining provenance. Distinguish this local theorem from topology-changing realization and physical action coverage.

review_anchor.boundary: The brief performed no independent compiler run. The repeated-interchange and higher-admission results below extend its reviewed frontier; they do not retroactively belong to its pinned evidence.

semantics.depends_on: Research prerequisites, not proof implications; a scoped rejection supplies knowledge, not a positive assembly witness.
semantics.constructed: Established only at the node's stated scope, supported by named source and recorded verification; this net audit does not rerun proofs.
semantics.declared: A supplied contract or convention, not a source-selection theorem.
semantics.rejected: The exact candidate under the stated unchanged source is rejected; broader alternatives remain possible.
semantics.cross_links: Organizational references only; no proof or verdict imported into a parent.

local_contract.foundation: Safe Cubical Agda, univalence and dependent transport; recorded toolchain Agda 2.8.0.1/Cubical 0.9. Pushout machinery exists elsewhere but is not the interpretation of this attachment adapter.
local_contract.seed_policy: Four graph-retaining vertex-pointed packages and actual derivations under Seeds.
local_contract.retained_signature: Directed incidence; no individually fixed ordered triangle-role colors.
local_contract.exactness: For a candidate decoder d:I->Out(v), postcomposition (T->I)->(T->Out(v)) is an equivalence for every T.
local_contract.continuation: Target-side reader; source side also retained. This convention is supplied, not uniquely forced.
local_contract.generic_rule_parameters: The twelve native schemas still admit unrestricted index/family/equivalence/witness parameters. Disciplined adapters do not certify every generic derivation.
local_contract.retention: Body, Complete code/value, actual native histories, readers, incidence and port laws, comparisons, higher witnesses and universe levels remain explicit.
local_contract.interpretation: Retained dependent extension and comparison, not a CW pushout, join, physical event or time evolution.

univalent initial-history paths and separately chosen reverse lift
higher-admission E family indexed by complete fillers

nodes.statement: Freeze the local source and supplied task/continuation conventions recorded above.
nodes.scope: A declared baseline, not uniqueness or parameter certification.
nodes.acceptance: All decisive conventions and source inputs remain named.
nodes.falsifier: An uncolored graph, selected seed or target-side convention is relabelled as derived without a theorem.

nodes.statement: The declared incidence family feeds native constructors; sigma satisfies the explicit source contract while tau does not.
nodes.scope: Four endpoint seeds and all-attachments policy supplied; not arbitrary topology generation.
nodes.acceptance: Actual native terms and source-boundary witnesses retained.
nodes.falsifier: Graph storage substitutes for incidence preservation or arbitrary index generation.

nodes.statement: Typed reified output supplies the next boundary and its retained derivation is consumed.
nodes.scope: The Ready adapter, not arbitrary Complete values or self-containing universes.
nodes.acceptance: Recover preceding payload and actual native premises.
nodes.falsifier: A fresh source derivation or readout replaces the preceding retained input.

nodes.statement: The fixed source comparison transports whole histories and extensions with a separately proved inverse.
nodes.scope: No forward-squared identity on arbitrary proof data is asserted.
nodes.acceptance: Retained chain/native-history and Ready squares plus inverse recovery.
nodes.falsifier: Vertex involution is substituted for a proof-level composition law.

nodes.statement: Base/fiber maps and equivalences lift, dependent reassociation is natural, and projection equivalence is exactly fiber contractibility.
nodes.scope: Admission predicate remains explicit; not a CW pushout or universal coherence theorem.
nodes.acceptance: Generic theorems and checked native feedback instance.
nodes.falsifier: Equivalence of a different map is treated as equivalence of the retained projection.

nodes.statement: Exact request realization determines Out representations up to decoder-preserving equivalence; attachment and identity comparison mix natively.
nodes.scope: Exactness and this task fragment are declared, not source-selected.
nodes.acceptance: Exact decoder theorem and retained native mixed derivations.
nodes.falsifier: Exactness or interchange is inferred from retention alone.

nodes.statement: Nonidentity source comparison is internal, supports continuation, and yields a retained attach/compare interchange.
nodes.scope: stay/exchange modes and target-side continuation; raw route packages remain unequal.
nodes.acceptance: Actual compare-rule derivations, port laws and both route recoveries.
nodes.falsifier: Point matching alone licenses a source-incompatible comparison or a wrong-side continuation.

nodes.statement: One explicit repeated-interchange diagram has a higher comparison of full fillers and compatible native histories.
nodes.scope: Local interpreted sethood is proved; not two successive source comparisons or arbitrary higher fibers.
nodes.acceptance: Map, selected-value and port-witness equality with both route records retained.
nodes.falsifier: Endpoint agreement or this one diagram is used to claim general higher coherence.

nodes.statement: Candidate: the exact bare atomic higher-path package is derivable from the unchanged Seeds and twelve rules.
nodes.scope: Rejected by the atomic-spine invariant for that exact Code; not semantic inability to represent the witness.
nodes.acceptance: An actual Resolve derivation of that exact package under the unchanged policy.
nodes.falsifier: The invariant proves true atomic spine impossible for any admitted output.

nodes.statement: The existing E/reflexivity/transport machinery admits a faithful envelope path recovering the same higher witness; a subsequent higher-rule control is derived.
nodes.scope: No new seeds/rules, but the filler and its uniform family are supplied or previously constructed parameters; local loop contractibility is proved.
nodes.acceptance: Native derivation, envelope equivalence and exact path recovery.
nodes.falsifier: Interpreted equivalence is used as exact Code admission, or witness admission is called source discovery.

nodes.statement: Candidate: equal selected points and all port readings force equality of comparison maps with extra retained content.
nodes.scope: Rejected by the hidden Boolean-fiber swap; does not refute the exact local outgoing family.
nodes.acceptance: A full map/higher comparison rather than readout agreement.
nodes.falsifier: Identity and swap fix ports/selected value but differ on retained hidden coordinates.

nodes.statement: Candidate: unrestricted native closure membership certifies generation of all parameter functions from the seed.
nodes.scope: Prior formal source/report: arbitrary supplied functions can enter through E indices; the bare-map obstruction has narrower syntactic scope.
nodes.acceptance: Every decisive parameter has a source-program derivation.
nodes.falsifier: The supplied function is recovered from an index in which it was already inserted.

nodes.statement: Four actual interchange cells give sequential/fused full-filler equality for two exchange comparisons and two attachments, with native higher-envelope admission and exact recovery.
nodes.scope: The second comparison is an explicit inverse-facing graph projection, not moveInitial applied twice. Local sethood and reader injectivity are proved. Literal atomic admission remains rejected.
nodes.acceptance: Fresh safe closure, retained original/intermediate Bodies and native histories, complete-filler equality, faithful-envelope equivalence and exact higher-path recovery.
nodes.falsifier: The inverse-facing control is relabelled as arbitrary forward/forward proof-transport coherence, or endpoint agreement substitutes for proved reader injectivity.

nodes.statement: For the existing chosen package paths, forward/backward lifts agree and forward squared cancels on arbitrary actual initial derivations and every finite retained chain, with binary mode and native-closure laws.
nodes.scope: Constructed by univalent path comparison and dependent point-path uniqueness over the set Vertex. Ready cancels to encode(decode r). The chosen triple-exchange overlap and Body-interface binding remain open.
nodes.acceptance: Compare the actual pointPath and inverse path; prove equality for arbitrary Resolve inputs, all retained chains, native closures and two dependent attachments under unchanged source choices.
nodes.falsifier: Vertex involution alone, fresh seed reset, judgmental equality, or proof irrelevance substitutes for the checked package-path transport argument.

nodes.statement: Bind the constructed actual forward-square law to forward/forward native histories in the Body two-comparison/two-attachment diagram.
nodes.scope: The inverse-facing Body diagram and binary forward law on Chain/closure are constructed separately. Their interface binding is not automatic.
nodes.acceptance: Retain the actual lifted initial derivations, transported edge witnesses and ports; construct/admit the full Body filler or identify the exact residual comparison.
nodes.falsifier: Fresh endpoint seeds replace the transported histories, or a Chain theorem is silently treated as a Body comparison theorem.
nodes.next_action: Use forward-back-initial and forward-square-initial to specify the actual forward-lifted Body operands; construct the adapter and four-cell comparison with all histories retained.
nodes.deliverable: Forward/forward Body binding with full higher admission, or a precise typed residual under the fixed source.
nodes.not_claimed: A general coherent C2 action or coherence induction from this finite diagram.

nodes.statement: Complete the higher compatibility of the now-proved unit/binary composition witnesses for the chosen source lifts.
nodes.scope: The forward-square law on actual proof data is proved in its own node. A coherent C2 action still requires comparison of the chosen composition paths, not just the mode table.
nodes.acceptance: Fill TripleExchangeOverlap and the specified unit/overlap boundaries, or classify an exact obstruction without erasing native proof data.
nodes.falsifier: A binary involution theorem or finite associative mode table is reported as a fully coherent action.
nodes.next_action: Compare forward-square (move c) with cong move (forward-square c) for arbitrary c, reusing the actual pointed-path square rather than selecting a new cancellation witness silently.
nodes.deliverable: Higher overlap theorem for the chosen binary witnesses, or a precise retained residual/obstruction.

nodes.statement: Certify decisive index, family, equivalence and higher-witness parameter programs for a named source fragment.
nodes.scope: A certified sublanguage or extension is explicit; embedding unrestricted old rules does not certify all old derivations.
nodes.acceptance: Origin ledger and typed program certificates distinguish supplied inputs, foundation operations and derived terms; replay arbitrary-function injection as a hostile.
nodes.falsifier: An E-envelope or successful compiler exit is treated as evidence that its supplied filler or parameter function was generated.
nodes.next_action: Reuse GeneratedContinuationContexts and ResolutionMapIntroductionGap; audit the exact family/alpha terms in HigherWitnessAdmission before adding any new constructor.
nodes.deliverable: Bounded parameter grammar and certificates or first missing program-introduction obligation.

nodes.statement: Classify source-permitted continuation sides and task menus rather than assume target-side/all-outgoing policy is uniquely selected.
nodes.scope: Alternatives can be the source-determined result; inequivalent policies do not refute expressive coverage.
nodes.acceptance: Named source/target/both-side interfaces, typed comparison or obstruction, and the extra datum needed for selection; preserve exactness relative to each declared request.
nodes.falsifier: A decoder silently changes the active boundary, a changed menu is called the same source, or selection is inferred from naturality alone.
nodes.next_action: Specify source-side and target-side continuation of one internal comparison and test their Out-fiber/reader transport with no chosen physical interpretation.
nodes.deliverable: Policy-family classification and any justified selection condition, not a fitted preferred policy.

nodes.statement: Determine which compatibility/admission hypotheses replace local sethood when loop fibers carry nontrivial content.
nodes.scope: The E envelope can add loop structure; projection equivalence requires a separate contractibility theorem.
nodes.acceptance: State nontruncated boundaries, distinguish supplied higher cells from constructed ones, and preserve both recovery and any residual noncontractible fiber.
nodes.falsifier: Set-level uniqueness or mere equality of ports is reused in a higher fiber without proof.
nodes.next_action: Factor the envelope/path-admission argument from its sethood assumption and name a sourced non-set test carrier; do not invent a desired gauge target.
nodes.deliverable: Conditional non-set theorem and a concrete obstruction or sourced test case.

nodes.statement: Extend admitted local comparisons to coherent finite composition in a specified fragment by induction or a stated higher-categorical construction.
nodes.scope: Not a conclusion from successful diagram counts; raw histories need not become equal.
nodes.acceptance: Explicit generators, coherence boundaries, induction/completion law and source-parameter hypotheses with witness recovery.
nodes.falsifier: Finite tests stand in for the unbounded argument or an external normalization theorem is applied before its frame agreements are supplied.
nodes.next_action: Use the 2c2a result and lift-composition laws to specify induction invariants and overlap cells; revisit prior normalization results at that exact interface.
nodes.deliverable: Scoped reusable coherence theorem or an identified first unfilled overlap.

nodes.statement: The declared source plus certified parameter discipline determines a classified family of coherently composable retained operations and higher admissions.
nodes.scope: Local structural objective; no universal physical symmetry or topology-changing coverage is inferred.
nodes.acceptance: Assemble compatible results on one frozen source/grammar/policy family with no parameter-origin or coherence gate bypass.
nodes.falsifier: Independent successes with different source assumptions are treated as one source-determination theorem.
nodes.next_action: Remain open until the named source, policy and coherence obligations are discharged together.
nodes.deliverable: Common-witness source-certified theorem, or retained scoped alternatives/obstructions.

blocked_by: No native-to-topological span/boundary/action interpretation has been specified for this local E adapter.
nodes.statement: Supply an actual comparison to a named equivariant pushout/join operation if such a topology-changing interpretation is intended.
nodes.scope: Separate branch. E attachment is not CW attachment by name; the prior circle/join benchmarks are reused, not repeated as discoveries.
nodes.acceptance: Specify source/target, actual span, attaching map, action and comparison law, or a mathematical obstruction to a named candidate.
nodes.falsifier: An E projection is called a cell attachment, a missing search result is called an obstruction, or a changed rule contract is called recovery.
nodes.next_action: Inspect the pinned pushout/circle/join predecessors and choose an explicit comparison problem before implementing.
nodes.deliverable: Declared realization adapter or precisely scoped obstruction.

blocked_by: A bounded structured model class and realization preserving action products have not been fixed.
nodes.statement: For a named model class, derive structured group/action comparisons with parameter dependence and product compatibility.
nodes.scope: Group names and bare homotopy shape are insufficient; object coverage and full faithfulness are only a sufficient route, not established premises.
nodes.acceptance: Specify model, action, realization, structured equivalences and action square; state the claimed coverage class.
nodes.falsifier: BU(1) is equated with electromagnetism or contractible R with a trivial translation action.
nodes.next_action: Choose a narrow independently specified action domain without fitting source parameters to the desired group.
nodes.deliverable: Coverage statement and typed realization obligations.

blocked_by: Physical model, observables, regime and independent empirical tests are not specified.
nodes.statement: Test a generated structured action on an independently specified physical model and observational regime.
nodes.scope: Separate empirical obligation; mathematical coherence, counts and native admission do not establish it.
nodes.acceptance: Named observables, dynamics/regime, external constraints and falsifiable comparisons preserving gauge/global/effective distinctions.
nodes.falsifier: Mathematical realization or a familiar symmetry label is substituted for physical validation.
nodes.next_action: Only after fixing the action/model interface, specify empirical tests independently of WG choices.
nodes.deliverable: Bounded physical comparison with explicit failures and scope.

evidence_policy.current_pin_scope: Named artifacts, cross-link contracts and locally available recorded receipt source hashes; not a complete transitive Agda/Cubical dependency manifest.
evidence_policy.future_proof_acceptance: Record exact theorem/parameters, complete dependency closure and versions, actual command/exits/negative controls and a reproducible receipt; keep input provenance separate from native admission.

publication: Owner-local files and reference edges only. No Registrar/graph-service publication, task claim, commit or push is performed by this update.
